newsitem.title: USA: Palestinian leader leaves U.S. after summit.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian leader leaves U.S. after summit.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat left Washington on Wednesday night after a two-day Middle East summit at the White House with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Jordan's King Hussein and President Bill Clinton.

Arafat and Netanyahu, who met privately for several hours during the hastily arranged summit, failed to resolve the differences that led to renewed violence, but agreed to resume Israeli-Palestinian peace talks.
Clinton called the meeting in the hope of rescuing the Middle East peace process and ending the unrest that has killed 58 Arabs and 15 Israelis.
